strategies: Validate and sanitize all function parameters to prevent buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
Document all potential security-critical operations to ensure coding standards and prevent hidden vulnerabilities.
Ensure all conditional checks are exhaustive, covering all possible cases, including edge cases.
Verify function parameters are copied or cloned to prevent unintended modifications to original data.
Implement explicit checks for null before using function parameters to prevent null pointer dereferences and buffer overflows.
Implement bounds checking for array or vector indices and string lengths to prevent out-of-bounds access and buffer overflows.
Review conditional statements with multiple checks for security issues.
Verify shared variables are properly synchronized to prevent concurrent modification issues.
Implement checks for sensitive data exposure in all functions that handle sensitive information.
Review error handling mechanisms to ensure errors are properly propagated to the caller.
Validate memory allocations and input data to prevent buffer overflows and ensure data integrity.
Assess changes in isolation, considering broader security context and potential unintended consequences.
